skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1500% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to a single enemy target in the back row in a 4-hit combo (affected only by advanced DMG reduction), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Permanently grants [Specialized Acceleration] to non-row allies. When using the ultimate skill for the first 6 rounds, additionally applies [Specialized Charm] to the main target. — [Specialized Acceleration]: Speed is increased to 94% of Nyan's speed; if a teammate's own speed is higher, it stays unchanged. [Specialized Charm]: The target immediately disengages from combat, uses some special skills and passive effects to attack a random enemy, then returns and skips their next active action; enemies with [Specialized Charm] have [All DMG Reduction] reduced by 20% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1500% > 2400% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG]. Ignore [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%. [Specialized Acceleration] speed increased to 94% > 98% of Nyan's speed.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] at the start of the battle. Removes all enemy [Suppression DMG Increase] and [Suppression DMG Reduction] debuffs. Immune to [Charm]/[Specialized Charm]. Reduces the amount of energy deducted by 2 when allies suffer additional energy loss during the first 5 rounds. Self has [Monster Affinity]. — [Monster Affinity]: When the core skill of a Monster character is activated, Nyan can be treated as one of any other currently missing character element (e.g. missing a duelist slot for the Gyoro Core — Nyan counts as a duelist so the Core activates, even though Nyan is a grappler).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] on entry 60% > 70%. Reduces energy deducted by 2 > 3 when allies suffer additional energy loss during the first 5 rounds.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] on entry 70% > 80%. Reduces energy deducted by 3 when allies suffer additional energy loss during the first 5 rounds.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gain 46% [Specialized Speed]. Applies [Life Link] to the ally with the highest ATK for 6 turns. After Nyan actively uses its skill, the ally with [Life Link] launches [Charged Pursuit] with 80% skill power, up to once per round. — [Life Link]: Nyan will not be defeated as long as the [Life Link] teammate is alive; if they are defeated, [Life Link] transfers to the next-highest-ATK teammate, up to 3 times. [Charged Pursuit]: Performs a DMG-type or AoE-healing Ultimate as a follow-up ATK; targets random, no energy cost.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gain [Specialized Speed] 46% > 54%. [Life Link] ally launches [Charged Pursuit] with 80% > 120% skill power.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Increases ally's speed to near deployer's speed (remains the same if ally is already faster).
